proposed.text: What is the correct sequence of steps in the change of use and occupancy process under PD 1096?

options.text: Inspection → Assessment → Submit B-12 → Certificate of Occupancy
Submit B-12 → Assessment → Inspection → Certificate of Occupancy
Assessment → Submit B-12 → Certificate of Occupancy → Inspection
Submit B-12 → Certificate of Occupancy → Inspection → Assessment

proposed.rationale: The proper process sequence under Sec. 702 is: (1) Submit NBC Form B-12 to initiate the application; (2) OBO conducts a fee and compliance Assessment; (3) Physical Inspection of the existing building; (4) Issuance of the Certificate of Occupancy upon satisfactory compliance. The inspection must occur before the certificate is issued — not after. Option A inverts the first two steps. Options C and D place the certificate before the inspection.
proposed.explanation: B-12 → Assessment → Inspection → Certificate of Occupancy. The sequence matters: you cannot issue the Certificate of Occupancy before inspecting the building. The inspection verifies that the building actually meets the Code requirements for the new use.
